Category: Seen Gods

Primarily Practiced In: Pockets within Rodda, Bahljet

Espirian Domains: The Hells (Obscurum)

Zenisia is the patron of those who have lost faith in gods, but remain hopeful of some form of higher power to guide them and their lives. They appear as a welcoming, loving entity, but they in fact prey upon their delusion and lost state to lead them astray. Many become unwilling or unwitting followers of Zenisia, but there are those who eschew gods altogether who end up embracing this deity for the promise that divine assistance is meant to lead those who follow them astray, and that is the fact of life itself. This gives many of Zenisia’s followers comfort that the only thing certain in the cosmic game of the world is uncertainty, and the honesty of this fact is what lets them continue to follow Zenisia and her swathes of Asura and many of their rakshasa creations. Zenisia is often worshipped alongside Darouga or is tangentially close to her, as their realms and domains often cross paths.

 Title Ram of Lost Piety

Edicts Encourage delusion and mania among the lost, destroy sources of knowledge       

Anathema Separate fact from fiction, rely on divine guidance

Areas of Concern Misinformation, Uncertainty, Wandering

Religious Symbol A broken compass, typically with ram horns upon it

Sacred Animal Ram

Sacred Colors White and Gold
